name: Fröschbrunna Coaster
editorial: Eight descriptions corrected, seven displayed operator fares and 106 dated seasonal overrides to end of February 2027. Removed unsupported accompaniment ages; source only confirms minimum age three and pregnancy restriction.

calendar.nuance: November and February weekends from 13:00 until at least 16:00, weather permitting. December and January closed. No precise later closing time inferred.

pricing: Adult €3.30 single and €11 four rides; child 6–14 €2.70 single and €10 four; under sixth birthday free; ten-ride family €20; group ten+ €2 per person and ride. No effective date stated.
